name: deck
description: A row per subagent, workflow agent, Kiro run (kiro-cli chat) and background task: Pixel Clawd or Kiro's ghost in a costume (random by default), a submarine for background tasks, with running, finished and failed counts, time and a memory warning from 70% (/deck details adds cost, requests, tokens processed, memory and Kiro's credits), and a dithered progress band above the prompt while they run.

autoOpen.title: Open the deck when the first agent starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane once per session, when the first subagent, workflow agent, Kiro run or background task starts. /deck pane opens it any time.

subagentCacheTtl.title: Subagent prompt cache lifetime
subagentCacheTtl.description: Prices cache writes at 1.25x input for 5m (the Claude Code default for subagents) or 2x for 1h.

costumes.title: Costumes
costumes.description: A costume for every agent (astronaut) or per target (opus=astronaut, haiku=pirate, kiro=chef). Costumes: astronaut, detective, engineer, chef, racer, pirate, crab. Targets: all, explore, plan, fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, kiro.

randomCostumes.title: Random costumes
randomCostumes.description: Each agent draws one of the seven costumes from its id when it starts. A costume chosen with /deck costume or the costumes option still wins; /deck costume random on|off changes it for the session.

showTasks.title: Show background tasks
showTasks.description: A row for each Bash command run in the background and each Monitor, as a submarine, until it ends. /deck tasks on|off changes it for the session.
